answer: A farm would have to colour 700 real map sheets at 700 real desks, while one colourist colours a single sheet. A stranger cannot borrow the relic that belongs to the keeper. Trust grows where the juniper can be checked, not where it is asserted. A colour proof tally is stamped at the colouring desk with the sheet number, the colour count, and the colourist name. Every honest record carries its tundra with it.
